const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Generate a replayable pick-and-drop trajectory for the frozen blocks_in_bin scene."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import numpy as np
+
+from rcb_robolab import Session
+
+
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+TRAJECTORY = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
+
+
+def main():
+    s = Session("blocks_in_bin", instance=INSTANCE)
+    p = s.primitives()
+    s.reset()
+
+    objects = s.objects()
+    print("state", s.status(), flush=True)
+    print("objects", json.dumps(objects, indent=2), flush=True)
+    print("ee", s.ee_pose(), "joints", s.joint_positions(), flush=True)
+
+    # Four comfortable landing spots inside the bin, each well away from a wall.
+    drop_xy = {
+        "yellow_block": (0.375, -0.255),
+        "red_block": (0.555, -0.255),
+        "green_block": (0.375, -0.125),
+        "blue_block": (0.555, -0.125),
+    }
+    quat = p["top_down_quat"](0.0)
+    s.record_start()
+    try:
+        for name in ("yellow_block", "red_block", "green_block", "blue_block"):
+            if s.episode_done:
+                break
+            x, y, _ = objects[name]["position"]
+            print(f"pick {name} at {(x, y)}", flush=True)
+            p["open_gripper"](steps=18)
+            p["move_ee"]([x, y, 0.16], quat, speed=0.20, max_steps=240, settle=2)
+            p["move_ee"]([x, y, 0.012], quat, speed=0.12, max_steps=240, settle=3)
+            p["close_gripper"](steps=20)
+            p["move_ee"]([x, y, 0.20], quat, speed=0.18, max_steps=240, settle=2)
+
+            dx, dy = drop_xy[name]
+            p["move_ee"]([dx, dy, 0.20], quat, speed=0.22, max_steps=300, settle=2)
+            # The held block is below the fingertip frame and clears the bin rim here.
+            p["move_ee"]([dx, dy, 0.15], quat, speed=0.12, max_steps=180, settle=3)
+            p["open_gripper"](steps=20)
+            p["hold"](steps=12)
+            print("after drop", name, s.status(), flush=True)
+
+        actions = s.record_stop()
+    except Exception:
+        actions = s.record_stop()
+        if len(actions):
+            s.save_trajectory(actions, TRAJECTORY, meta={"generator": "gen.py", "partial": True})
+        raise
+
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, TRAJECTORY, meta={"generator": "gen.py"})
+    print("saved", TRAJECTORY, "actions", actions.shape, "status", s.status(), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
